input.clock: INSPVA receiver time bridged from ROS headers; no pose used to fit the clock
input.inputInterpolation: offline linear reconstruction of recorded input samples
input.reference: NovAtel odom body-origin XY and quaternion yaw; also mapping reference
input.gpsInput: all covered recorded odom positions; no GNSS heading measurement
input.lidarInput: accepted full/directional geometric samples; the continuous adapter rejects insufficient information

provenance.identity: UMN identifies MnCAV as a 2021 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid.
provenance.stock_specifications: 2273 kg EPA curb mass, 3.089 m wheelbase, 55.5/44.5 axle load split, 16.2 steering ratio; actual loaded MnCAV mass is unknown.
provenance.lf_lr: Derived static unladen CG distances from published axle load fractions.
provenance.yawInertia: Explicit uniform rectangular planform approximation, not a measured MnCAV inertia.
provenance.cornering_stiffness: Unidentified nominal prior: existing generic model stiffnesses scaled by the stock mass ratio. Not a manufacturer specification.
provenance.sensitivity: Repeat the experiment at 0.7 and 1.3 times nominal inertia and both axle stiffnesses; nominal mass and geometry remain fixed.
provenance.input_offsets: Fixed signs plus median offsets from the independent calibration drive; no online truth injection. Residual road-bank and sensor-to-CG lever-arm errors remain.

rejected_direct_identification.reason: Nonphysical solution and unknown INS-to-CG reference point. This drive does not establish calibrated MnCAV bicycle parameters.

matching.motionSource: recorded speed and corrected gyro with actual lateral-observer velocity; causal zero-order hold
matching.clockSource: INSPVA receiver GPS seconds interpolated on ROS stamp; edge extrapolation only
matching.reference: nearest matched NovAtel odom base_link GNSS/INS pose, also used for mapping
matching.knownTilt: recorded GNSS/INS roll/pitch through quaternion yaw/tilt decomposition
matching.timingScope: map crop, fresh coarse perception, D2D and pose event; excludes disk read and offline preparation
matching.diskLoading: blocks loaded before processing; diskLoadMs is block time divided by block frame count
matching.mapOverlap: same sequence used for mapping and query; includes query observations

reconstruction.headingUnwrapAssumption: Adjacent recorded yaw changes are less than pi; cycle slips are not verified.
reconstruction.rejectedFramePolicy: Retain frame evaluation; no new measurement knot. Reconstruct from adjacent accepted poses offline.
reconstruction.measurementPolicy: Exact accepted pose/information at its capture time; linear reconstruction between accepted frames.

execution: All matching completed and saved before global integration; capture-time zero-delay injection.
rejectedFrames: No accepted measurement: cached pose is NaN. Continuous input is interpolation of adjacent accepted frames.
evaluation: Original 100 Hz grid and all 1170 native frame times scored separately. INSPVA is same-receiver diagnostic reference, not independent truth.
